name: v78_comp_raw_original_high_decay
hypothesis: The v24 raw competitor-return reversal was strong but TO 37.7%; keep the raw signal and raise decay instead of smoothing the input, which killed strength in v25.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.30 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry)
notes: Direct high-decay repair of mL8jgJkX; submit only if TO <=25% and corr remains clean.

name: v78_comp_raw_lower_reversal_risk
hypothesis: Lower the close/open parent and add risk relief to reduce turnover and correlation while preserving the raw competitor-return core.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.16 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.17 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Tests whether lower intraday-reversal weight can retain Sharpe while clearing turnover.

name: v78_comp_raw_social_small_confirm

expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.16 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.16 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.08 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.06 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Strict corr gate vs JjpPv3N2 and mL8jgJkX-like close/open actives.

name: v78_comp_raw_fast_earnings_tiny_confirm
hypothesis: A tiny fast-earnings sleeve may lift raw competitor-return fitness without making the alpha a fast-news clone.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.16 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.08 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry)
notes: Fast-news sleeve is small; reject if corr moves to e7OQoveE/JjpPv3N2.

name: v78_comp_raw_option_breakeven_small

expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.14 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.16 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)

name: v78_comp_raw_longer_rank_market
hypothesis: Use a longer rank window on the raw competitor-return reversal instead of ts_mean smoothing, aiming to lower turnover without destroying the short-term relative signal.
expression: 0.44 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 40), industry) + 0.16 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.16 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 90), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Alternative repair: longer rank window, no social/fast/option sleeve.
